class.name: FauxBuildRuntime
class.brief_description: Hosts the FauxBuild world runtime inside a Godot scene.

description.para: The single owner of the FauxBuild world state within the scene tree. In later milestones this node mounts content sources, loads maps, owns the mutable [code]WorldState[/code], advances the fixed-step simulation, accepts world commands, and drains world events. Godot presentation reads through this node; it never modifies a parallel copy of the world.
Milestone M1 scope: class registration and a core-version probe.
Returns the linked [code]fauxbuild_core[/code] version string, proving that the extension is linked against the pure C++ core.
